“林总。”

一道声音。

清冷，但不冰。

林川转过身。

顾清烟站在走廊的另一侧，目光径直落在他脸上

“你今天讲得很好。”

停顿了一下。

“有几个点，我很认同。”

林川笑了一下，走近两步，语气平稳：“顾总这句夸奖，分量不轻。”

顾清烟没有绕弯。

“顾氏这边后面可能会有一些项目，”她说，“如果有合适的可以合作，这是我的名片。”

说着，从外套口袋里取出一张名片，递过来。

名片极简，冷灰色，名字加一个手机号。没有头衔，没有公司全称，甚至连lOgO都没有。

林川接过，低头看了一眼，随手收进上衣内袋。

“行，我记下了。”他回了一句，“后面有合适的，我联系顾总。”

顾清烟点了一下头。

然后转身走了。

背影笔直，高跟鞋踩在地板上，声音清脆，不多停留一秒。

苏晚棠紧跟上来，把声音压到最低，但语气里压不住那点兴奋：“老板，她居然主动给你留电话。”

林川笑了笑没有说话。

走廊里还没散干净，张立恒已经挤过来了，手机握在手里，脸涨得通红。

“林总！”他几乎是冲上来的，“我这部手机从你讲话结束就没停过！全是问九州创投的！”

他说这话的时候，嘴角压都压不住。一个做了十几年园区的中年人，第一次觉得自己押对了宝。

“明天，我带完整资料去你公司，咱们把后面的规划顺一遍，行不行？”

“行。”林川给了一个字，拍了拍他肩膀，“把底层数据都带过来，不用挑，全带。”

张立恒使劲点头，像是生怕林川后悔。

周围还有人在递名片。园区系统的、资管圈的、招商口子的，一张接一张。林川保持着恰到好处的微笑，一张张接过，不多聊，也不敷衍。

有几个老资历的园区负责人围过来，说话的姿态跟十分钟前完全是两个人。

“林总，我是高科园的刘建，有空一定要来我们园区指导指导。”

“林总，我是汇添富的，你们九州创投的产业基金，咱们可以深入交流一下。”

林川一一应对，不卑不亢。

余光里，周处长从旁边走过。

那张脸上硬挤出一个比哭还难看的笑：“小林啊，讲得不错，以后常联系。”

林川连看都没看他一眼，只是淡淡地点了下头，直接把周处长晾在了原地。

周明辉跟在后面，头都不敢抬，灰溜溜地钻进了电梯。

"Mr. Lin."

A voice.

Cool, but not icy.

Lin Chuan turned around.

Gu Qingyan stood on the other side of the corridor, her eyes falling directly on his face

"You spoke very well today."

There was a pause.

"There are several points that I agree with."

Lin Chuan smiled, took two steps closer, and said in a calm tone: "Mr. Gu's compliment is quite weighty."

Gu Qingyan didn't make any detours.

"Gu's side may have some projects in the future," she said. "If there is someone suitable to cooperate with, this is my business card."

As he spoke, he took out a business card from his coat pocket and handed it over.

The business card is minimalist, cool gray, with the name and a mobile phone number.There is no title, no full company name, not even lOgO.

Lin Chuan took it, glanced down, and put it into his inner pocket.

"Okay, I'll note it down." He replied, "If someone is suitable later, I'll contact Mr. Gu."

Gu Qingyan nodded.

Then he turned around and left.

The back was straight, the high heels stepped on the floor, the sound was clear and did not stay for a second longer.

Su Wantang followed closely, keeping her voice as low as possible, but unable to suppress the excitement in her tone: "Boss, she actually took the initiative to leave you a phone number."

Lin Chuan smiled and said nothing.

Before the corridor was cleared, Zhang Liheng had already squeezed in, holding the phone in his hand and his face flushed.

"Mr. Lin!" He almost rushed up, "My cell phone has not stopped since you finished speaking! All questions are from Jiuzhou Venture Capital!"

When he said this, he couldn't hold back the corners of his mouth.A middle-aged man who has been working in the park for more than ten years feels that for the first time he has made the right bet.

"Tomorrow, I will bring the complete information to your company, and we can go through the subsequent planning, okay?"

"Okay." Lin Chuan gave him a word and patted him on the shoulder, "Bring all the underlying data over. No need to pick, just bring it all."

Zhang Liheng nodded vigorously, as if he was afraid that Lin Chuan would regret it.

There were people around handing out business cards.From the park system, from the asset management circle, from the investment promotion channels, one after another.Lin Chuan kept a just right smile and accepted the items one by one without talking too much or being perfunctory.

Several senior park managers came around, speaking in exactly the same manner as they did ten minutes ago.

"Mr. Lin, I am Liu Jian from the Hi-Tech Park. Please come to our park for guidance when you have time."

"Mr. Lin, I'm from China Universal, and we can have an in-depth discussion about your Jiuzhou Venture Capital's industrial fund."

Lin Chuan responded one by one, neither humble nor overbearing.

Out of the corner of his eye, Director Zhou walked by.

The face forced a smile that was uglier than crying: "Xiao Lin, what you said is good, please contact me often in the future."

Lin Chuan didn't even look at him, he just nodded lightly and left Director Zhou where he was.

Zhou Minghui followed behind, not daring to raise his head, and got into the elevator dejectedly.
